rachel: Heads-up — execs want a clear 'isolation pathways' doc that maps customer profile -> default routing policy + gated launch checklist. Need a decision for Q3 planning.

tom: Quick ask: can we produce a one-pager that shows the operational delta between modes (shared, soft-slice, hard-island) and the minimal infra changes to enable each? Sales needs it for pricing.

ian: Proposal: three lanes with explicit policy precedence: 1) Residency enforcement (region lock) 2) Tenant-slice (soft isolation, scheduler reservations) 3) Tenant-island (physical separation). Each lane gets a launch gate list (perf cert, residency proof, KMS/CMK test, audit retention set).

mika: Ops note: tenant-slice requires per-tenant egress shaping + admission control. We also need stable fallback semantics documented: slice can fallback to shared pool on overload unless customer opts out. Island must not fallback automatically.

rachel: For prioritization — which unblocks most pilots? My estimate: residency+CMK first (hosted-residency) -> unlocks ~60% of pilots. Tenant-slice next; island is long lead.

tom: Finance asked for cost multipliers and a sample billing SKU. Recommend baseline=1.0, slice=+1.8x, island=+3.5x (very rough). Need finance to validate.

ian: Infra rough timeline: routing policy engine + predicate support ~3w, residency verification hooks ~2w, CMK integration ~2w, scheduler reservations + reservation eviction policy ~6w. End-to-end for slice ~10w if parallelized.

mika: Launch gates we should require: synthetic perf pass (p95 target), chaos test (simulate AZ loss), residency proof (verified by audit pipeline), KMS rotate test, two canary customers, runbook + SRE pager. Also contract clause for cutover credits.

rachel: Action items: Ian -> publish policy precedence RFC with sample DSL and a small example: `route: [{if: region=="eu", then: residency:true}, {if: tenant.slice=="gold", then: reserve:true}]`. Tom -> cost deltas ask to finance. Mika -> scheduler constraints + canary plan. I'll sync with sales on pilot windows.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket PATHWAYS-101 "isolation-pathways: one-pager + RFC" assigned ian. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/PATHWAYS-101

mika: Small engineering detail: include a `route_decision` header in every response with reason and fallback step for audits. Also recommend opt-in high-fidelity trace header for pilots.

ian: Will do. Planning sync target: converge on MVP (hosted-residency + CMK) and schedule tenant-slice design into next quarter.

rachel: Thanks team — agree on order. :thumbsup:
